note: Unknown-call scenarios for the screening classifier. Kanglish entries are unverified drafts. Hinglish in Latin script. caller_turns are the two caller answers.

scenarios.label: legit
caller_turns: Sir Swiggy delivery se bol raha hoon, main gate pe hoon.
Order ka OTP bata dijiye.
scenarios.trap: OTP request, but from a delivery person at your door

expected.reason_for_call: Food delivery at the gate, needs handover OTP

scenarios.label: legit
caller_turns: Amazon ka parcel hai aapke naam pe, address confirm kar dijiye.
Delivery OTP aaya hoga, wo bata do.
scenarios.trap: Parcel + OTP, but no threat, no money, order is real

expected.reason_for_call: Amazon delivery, address and handover OTP

scenarios.label: legit
caller_turns: Sir Ola driver bol raha hoon, pickup point pe pahunch gaya.
Gate number bata dijiye aur ride OTP de dijiye.
scenarios.trap: OTP request, but ride you booked

expected.reason_for_call: Cab driver at pickup, ride OTP

scenarios.label: legit
caller_turns: Hello, Dr. Rao ke clinic se bol rahi hoon, kal subah 10 baje ka appointment hai.
Aap aa rahe hain na? Reschedule karna ho to bata dijiye.
scenarios.trap: Official-sounding caller, but just an appointment

scenarios.label: legit
caller_turns: SBI branch se bol raha hoon, aapka cheque book ready hai.
Branch aakar le jaiye, koi OTP ya password nahi chahiye.
scenarios.trap: Bank call that explicitly asks for nothing

expected.reason_for_call: Bank branch: cheque book ready for pickup

scenarios.label: legit

scenarios.label: legit

Shaam ko milte hain kya, cricket khelne?

scenarios.label: legit

scenarios.trap: 'band rahega' sounds like disconnection threat, but it is a notice

scenarios.label: legit

scenarios.trap: OTP mentioned in advance, for delivery

scenarios.label: legit
caller_turns: Hello, main Infosys HR se bol rahi hoon, aapka resume dekha tha.

scenarios.trap: Unknown caller, no fee or sensitive ask

scenarios.label: legit
caller_turns: BESCOM se bol raha hoon, meter reading ke liye kal visit hoga.
Phone par koi payment nahi leni, bas visit batana tha.
scenarios.trap: Electricity company, but no payment or threat

scenarios.label: suspicious
caller_turns: Sir aapke liye pre-approved personal loan hai, 5 lakh tak.
Ek link bheja hai, interest rate bahut kam hai.
scenarios.trap: Likely telemarketing spam, not a threat

expected.reason_for_call: Unsolicited loan offer with a link

scenarios.label: suspicious
caller_turns: Hello, aapka bank KYC pending hai, link bheja hai.
Jaldi update kijiye warna dikkat ho sakti hai.
scenarios.trap: Classic phishing shape but no explicit threat or money ask yet

scenarios.label: suspicious
caller_turns: Sir LIC policy lapse ho gayi hai, revive karwa lijiye.
Aaj hi renew karenge to bonus milega.
scenarios.trap: Sales pressure, probably not criminal

scenarios.label: suspicious
caller_turns: Congratulations, aapne survey jeeta hai, gift mil sakta hai.
Bas apna address aur ID bata dijiye.
scenarios.trap: Prize bait asking for ID, but no payment yet

expected.reason_for_call: Prize survey asking for ID details

scenarios.label: suspicious
caller_turns: Parcel aaya hai, address galat tha.
Link par click karke address update kijiye.
scenarios.trap: Delivery wording but pushes a link instead of arriving

scenarios.label: scam
caller_turns: Main CBI officer Vikram Singh bol raha hoon, aapke Aadhaar se ek parcel pakda gaya hai, usme drugs mile hain.
Aap abhi video call par rahiye, kisi ko mat batana, warna arrest ho jayega.
scenarios.trap: Fake authority + arrest threat + secrecy + stay on video

scenarios.label: scam
caller_turns: TRAI se bol raha hoon, aapke number se illegal calls ho rahi hain, 2 ghante me SIM band hoga.
Police case se bachna hai to abhi mere officer se baat kijiye.
scenarios.trap: Fake regulator + deadline + police threat

scenarios.label: scam
caller_turns: Bijli board se bol raha hoon, bill pending hai, aaj raat 9:30 baje connection kat jayega.
Is number par abhi UPI se 4,500 rupees bhej dijiye.
scenarios.trap: Deadline threat + payment to a personal number

scenarios.label: scam

scenarios.trap: Parcel + customs + fine payment (contrast with L02)

scenarios.label: scam

scenarios.label: scam
caller_turns: Papa, main hospital me hoon, accident ho gaya, jaldi paise bhejo.

scenarios.trap: Emotional urgency + money + secrecy

scenarios.label: scam
caller_turns: Main aapke bank ka officer hoon, account me suspicious activity hai.
AnyDesk download kijiye aur OTP bataiye, main account secure kar dunga.
scenarios.trap: Remote-access app + OTP

expected.reason_for_call: Bank impersonation asking for remote access and OTP

scenarios.label: scam
caller_turns: SBI fraud team se bol raha hoon, aapke card se abhi 40,000 nikalne ki koshish hui.
Card block karna hai to abhi OTP bataiye jo aapko aaya hai.
scenarios.trap: OTP request that looks like L01 but comes with 'your account is at risk' (contrast with L01)

expected.reason_for_call: Fake bank fraud team asking for OTP
